evidence_status: October-November 2025 is already inspected development evidence; no independent holdout; December outcomes reserved and inaccessible
target: Recorded positive gross fulfilled product units by order date; normalized statuses completed, shipped, returned. Returns included because goods left stock and returned goods are not proven resalable. Exclude cancelled and processing, nonpositive quantity; remove identical duplicate transactions; stop on conflicting transaction IDs.
missing_dates: Calendar-day aggregation of recorded transactions: absent lines contribute no recorded units, not asserted zero customer demand or open-store exposure. Every chain calendar date appears; individual store operating and assortment coverage unknown. Conditional on released extract completeness, no imputation of lost demand.
population: All 336 product/store keys in current policy and inventory; fixed population for every candidate. Historical assortment is unknown; static current-assortment development simulation, not reconstruction of historical buying decisions.
training: Only orders dated on or before each origin; rolling means use last 28 or 84 calendar days inclusive. Seasonal factors use earlier years only. Historical status-change times unavailable, so final recorded status defines a conditional target; no claim of fully recoverable as-of status.
evaluation_dates: 2025-09-29 through 2025-11-30, depending on origin and horizon; overlapping windows retained and treated as dependent

horizons.primary: Current supplied lead time plus 7-day review, 8-14 days for each key
horizons.secondary: Next 7 days, same keys and origins

horizon_policy_caveat: Current synthetic policy used as a fixed scenario at all origins, not claimed historically available. Select and deploy on same coverage horizon, also report next-week results.
baseline: 84-day per-key calendar average times horizon. Analytical interpretation of recent months, not a proven replica of customer's unspecified buying rule.
candidates: pooled84: 50% mean84 plus 50% product-total times store-total divided by chain-total daily rate, all from last84 days

seasonal84: mean84 multiplied by prior-years chain target-month daily rate divided by prior-years chain trailing84 same-calendar-season daily rate; factor clipped to 0.5-2; target month is midpoint of horizon
primary_metric: Root mean squared error in product units per key/coverage window, equal weight per key-origin. Larger misses receive more weight because they create larger replenishment planning gaps; this is recorded-unit forecast accuracy, not cost, availability or savings.
selection_rule: Lowest primary RMSE. Within 1% of best select mean84 baseline if eligible, otherwise mean28 then pooled84 then seasonal84. 1% is a parsimony tie convention, not a business-success threshold.
secondary: zero-record windows and transactions per key
gross versus exclusion of returns and inclusion of processing sensitivity
uncertainty: Development empirical forecast residual quantiles are descriptive, not calibrated service levels; show order sensitivity to residual uplift and target interpretation. No invented stockout exposure, costs, price pooling or historical inventory.
ordering_rule: Illustrative periodic review: ceil(max(0, coverage forecast + supplied safety stock - usable on hand - incoming due by coverage end)), rounded up to supplied order multiple and minimum when positive. Track pre-arrival risk separately; do not subtract returns from usable snapshot or double-count inbound. No budget or capacity supplied.
success_gate: Not ready: externally predeclared meaningful threshold missing and no genuinely untouched evaluation or required frozen independent artifacts. No development result can close this gate.
